definitions.explanation: Care taken to avoid danger or mistakes; being careful and watchful.

examples.japanese: {火|ひ}の{用心|ようじん}をしてください。
{用心|ようじん}に{越|こ}したことはない。
examples.notes: Common saying meaning 'better safe than sorry'

examples.japanese: {夜道|よみち}は{用心|ようじん}して{歩|ある}いた{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: You should walk carefully on the streets at night.

notes:
USAGE: {用心|ようじん} emphasizes being careful to prevent problems or danger. It's often used with する to form a verb.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{用心|ようじん}する (to be careful, to take precautions)
・{火|ひ}の{用心|ようじん} (fire safety/prevention)
・{用心|ようじん}に{越|こ}したことはない (can't be too careful)
・{用心深|ようじんぶか}い (cautious, wary)
・{用心棒|ようじんぼう} (bodyguard)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{注意|ちゅうい} - attention, caution
・{警戒|けいかい} - vigilance, precaution
